title: Mara and the Crown
author: Zephyrine Underhill
blurb: Felix Blackwood, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
